build_model_md4: build an MD4 diffusion model instance from a config dictionary with specified architecture parameters
build_model_genmd4: build a GenMD4 diffusion model instance from a config dictionary with specified architecture parameters
create_model_from_config: create a model instance by passing a ConfigDict with model_type set to md4 or genmd4
test_get_model: test the get_model function with different model_type configurations
review_get_model: review the get_model function that dispatches to MD4 or GenMD4 based on config.model_type
